sentences.text: 2024 Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh 22.05.2024 CRR/2122/ 2024 Court No.34 Item.57 (Srimanta)
In Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
And In the matter of: Sree Narayan Pachisia @ Shreenarayan Pachisia @ Narayan Pachisia ...Petitioner.

entities.text: Sree Narayan Pachisia @ Shreenarayan Pachisia @ Narayan Pachisia
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Sourav Chatterjee, Mr. Shailendra Jain, Ms. S. Agarwal, Mr. Ankit Agarwal, Mr. Aditya Tiwari ...for the petitioner.

The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party no. 1 through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no. 2 by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.

The subject-matter of the case is the continuation of the proceedings under the relevant provisions of the Indian Penal Code when subsequently legislature in its wisdom has enacted Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Having regard to the contention so advanced, I direct the revisional application to appear in the Combined Monthly List of July, 2024.
Liberty is granted to the petitioner to pray for interim order after effecting service upon the opposite parties.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
